name: Google Flow (Veo 3.1)
length_note: Flow makes 8 s clips only: pick 8 s. The app keeps the clip's real length and cuts a speaking shot 0.3 s after its last word.

modes.keyframe: Frames to Video: image 1 (the keyframe) as the first frame.
modes.references: Ingredients to Video: up to 3 images (a character, a scene, a style).

closing: No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
prompt_notes: Paste the prompt into Flow's prompt box as it is: it follows Google's own five parts (cinematography, subject, action, context, style).
The spoken line stays in quotes, in the story's language: do not translate it.
Audio is always on in Veo 3.1: the prompt says which voice speaks and that nothing else does.
where_to_paste: Flow → New project → Frames to Video (with the keyframe) or Ingredients to Video (with the sheets) → set 9:16 → paste the prompt → Generate. Download the take you like as MP4.

credits.note: Veo 3.1 Fast: 20 credits a clip on AI Pro, 10 on Ultra; Quality: 100 (read 2026-10-04).
